title: in-app-purchases contract
description: The app's purchase facts, read by the in-app-purchases skill's checkers. The developer decides them; the checkers hold the code, the StoreKit configuration and the App Store Connect script to them.

productId.description: The one non-consumable's id, the same in the App Store and on Google Play: lowercase letters, digits, '.' and '_', starting with a letter or digit, at most 40 characters (naming-conventions' product-id grammar, valid on both stores). Never changed or reused.

familyShareable.description: Family Sharing for the product. Default false; once turned on in App Store Connect it can never be turned off for that product.

amount.description: The price point in the base territory's currency, as a decimal string ('2.99').

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the base territory's currency.

baseTerritory.description: App Store Connect territory id (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3): USA, DEU, GBR, ...

storeTexts.description: The product's display name (2-30 characters) and description (at most 45) per App Store Connect locale. The app never shows them.

reviewNote.description: What App Review reads about the product.

paywallScreenDir.description: Folder of the paywall screen (its state test IDs are checked there).

catalogKeys.description: Message keys every catalog must hold.

priceKeys.description: Keys whose message shows the price: each takes {priceText}.

stateTestIds.description: Test IDs the paywall screen must carry, one per state and notice.

allowedApis.description: Opt-in server profile: expo-iap server APIs the app decided to use (verifyPurchase, verifyPurchaseWithProvider, kitApi, KitApiError). useIAP and auto-finishing can never be allowed.

allowedConfigWords.description: Opt-in store profiles: expo-iap plugin switches the app decided to use (iapkitApiKey, alternativeBilling, onside, horizon, fireOS, vegaOS and their EXPO_IAP_* variables).

entitlementWritersAllowedIn.description: Globs or folders ending in / (besides the purchase service and the premium store) that may call grantPremium/revokePremium: test-only folders only (debug-menu-and-test-hooks' src/services/test-hooks/ and src/features/debug/).
